policy: These are conditional opinions. Re-check the v0.107.1 fact record and the current deck before every pick.

cards.prior: High-ceiling scaling power and a reasonable speculative early pick because many Necrobinder cards apply debuffs.
pick_when: The deck already applies Weak, Vulnerable, Doom, Hang, or other debuffs
The route can afford a 2-energy setup turn
AoE debuff application is available
avoid_when: The next fights demand immediate front-loaded output and the deck cannot create a setup window
The deck has almost no debuff density and cannot add it soon

cards.prior: Premium repeatable energy when the deck's important damage does not depend heavily on Strength.
pick_when: Doom, fixed power damage, Souls, or utility consume the extra energy
The deck has expensive cards or replay loops
avoid_when: Multi-hit or Strength-scaled attacks are the main win condition
The immediate Strength loss creates a near-term damage failure
interactions: Poor with Pull From Below unless upgrades/enhancements offset the Strength loss

cards.prior: Very strong Act 1 and Act 2 stabilizer: one card supplies AoE and Block at unusually high rates, but consumes a living Osty.
pick_when: AoE or immediate defense is missing
Osty is often small or already expected to die
A Summon can be played after Bone Shards
avoid_when: A large persistent Osty is the deck's central scaling engine and cannot be restored
The deck already solves AoE and cannot tolerate losing Osty
interactions: Community reports a Necro Mastery interaction; verify live/source semantics before relying on it

cards.prior: Top-tier flexible defense because Weak reduces future attack pressure while Ethereal supports the character's payoff package.
pick_when: Early defense is needed
Weak, Ethereal, or Sleight of Flesh synergies matter
avoid_when: Only when the deck already has excessive conditional defense or the matchup punishes Skill plays

cards.prior: Premium long-fight control and a core enabler for debuff scaling; much stronger when Weak can be extended or reapplied.
pick_when: Boss/elite scaling is unresolved
The deck contains Sleight of Flesh or reliable Weak
avoid_when: The deck cannot pay its setup cost before the next immediate damage check

cards.prior: High-value energy engine when Friendship's Strength penalty would damage the current attack plan.
pick_when: Energy is the bottleneck
The deck needs to preserve Strength
avoid_when: The deck cannot exploit recurring energy or needs immediate defense/damage instead

cards.prior: Often underrated defensive scaling; upgrade access materially affects how quickly it becomes reliable.
pick_when: The route has an upgrade window
Long fights and delayed defense are expected
avoid_when: Immediate block is the only unmet need and no upgrade is available

cards.prior: Strong defensive pickup that also feeds debuff and Ethereal packages.
pick_when: The deck needs defense with scaling relevance
Sleight of Flesh or Ethereal payoffs are present
avoid_when: The deck is overloaded with slow setup and lacks immediate output

cards.prior: High-value AoE debuff application, especially with Sleight of Flesh and Doom payoffs.
pick_when: AoE is missing
The deck has debuff triggers
avoid_when: Energy/setup density is already too high and the next fights are single-target races

cards.prior: Strong general damage and a useful AoE answer; community reports particularly good Act 2 performance.
pick_when: AoE remains unsolved
Doom or debuff support exists
avoid_when: The deck already has enough damage and needs block/energy consistency

cards.prior: A serviceable scaling finisher that improves with deck cycles, but is conditional and can conflict with Friendship.
pick_when: Ethereal density is already high
The deck can cycle or replay it
No stronger finisher is offered
avoid_when: The deck cannot survive long enough to cycle

cards.prior: A synergy-dependent scaling component rather than an automatic early pick; rises with Soul generation and reliable cycling.
pick_when: Soul generation and draw are already functional
The deck needs block-ignoring scaling
avoid_when: Taken only as a speculative archetype label without a Soul engine
